subject: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@aperturehealth.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix

Hi Jamie / Priya — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared plan to start the 4‑week trial. Please reply with any edits or missing owners.

Summary of goals (from today's discovery):
- Validate integration of Redwood API into Aperture’s ingestion pipeline for clinical note summarization (target latency <= 200 ms p95 per request).
- Confirm output quality: ROUGE/Lexical tests on 500 sample notes, target F1 >= 0.78 relative to team labels.
- Measure cost per 1k tokens under expected load (10 concurrent users, ~2k tokens/session).

Immediate asks / actions: 
1) Access & auth: Priya to confirm SSO user list or, alternatively, provide IP ranges for allowlist + service account email for API key provisioning. (owner: Aperture).
2) API keys & test project: Redwood (Ben) to provision scoped trial API key and temp model quota for the test workload.
3) Success matrix: Attached is our draft success matrix and acceptance checklist (sheet 1). Please mark any additions by EOD Fri.
4) Kickoff sync: Proposed 30m check-in next Tue 10/27 to verify access and run first smoke tests.

Attachments: 20261020-aperture-success-matrix.xlsx, onboarding-ssh-ip-roster.txt (sample allowlist template)

Thanks — I’ll loop in Aditya (cc) if we need approval for additional trial credits or SLA exceptions.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0128
From: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@aperturehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aperturehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix

Thanks Camila — that aligns with what we discussed. Quick clarification items from our side: 

1) We prefer SSO (Okta) for the team, but can fall back to IP allowlist + API key for the initial smoke tests. Priya will provide the Okta metadata and an allowlist of CIDR ranges if needed.
2) For the API key, we need it scoped to the following endpoints: /v1/generate (text), /v1/embeddings. No writeback.
3) Data handling: confirm that logs with full prompt text will not be retained by Redwood beyond the trial unless we opt in. Need this clarified for our security team.

We'll aim to send Okta metadata and a preliminary CIDR list by Thu 10/22. Kickoff 10/27 works for us.

—Jamie
Jamie Lin
Sr. ML Engineer, Aperture Health
jamie.lin@aperturehealth.com | (617) 555-8192
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@aperturehealth.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix

Hi Jamie — happy to handle the API key and scoping. Details: 

- I will create a scoped trial API key limited to read/generate and embeddings only. We can restrict by IP ranges and optionally bind to a service account email.
- For Okta SSO, we support SAML2.0; if you share the metadata XML I can add your IdP to our test tenant and invite the users you indicate.
- Regarding logs: by default trial telemetry includes aggregate usage and latency metrics. Raw prompt/response text is NOT retained past 7 days for trial tenants unless you opt into logging for QA. I will add a short note and a link to our privacy page in the onboarding doc.

Action items I will do this week:
- Provision API key (expires in 30 days) and paste it to a secure DocuSign-style link (or your preferred secrets manager).
- Add sample curl snippets and a Postman collection for the endpoints.

To move quickly, please confirm: (a) preferred delivery method for the key (Vault link, Okta service account, or encrypted email), and (b) list of one or two CIDR ranges if you want IP bind in place before SSO.

Attachment: onboarding-ssh-ip-roster.txt (template for CIDR entries)

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@aperturehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Jamie Lin <jamie.lin@aperturehealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 10:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix

Thanks Ben — we prefer Vault for secrets. Attaching our preliminary CIDR list (internal office + cloud nat):
- 18.210.32.0/22
- 34.202.64.0/19

We’ll also share the Okta metadata by EOD Thu if we decide to go SSO for user onboarding. One more ask from security: can you add a short checklist of the privacy settings you mentioned (where to toggle raw logs retention and how to request deletion)? That will speed our internal review.

Priya
Priya Shah
Security Program Manager | Aperture Health
priya.shah@aperturehealth.com
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Trial kickoff: auth orchestration, access roster, and success matrix

Camila — thanks for the clear plan. Approve the scoped API key and 30‑day trial quota for Aperture (deal AFF-2026-312). If Aperture requests extended retention or additional tokens beyond the plan we can approve up to an additional 20% for pilot purposes; larger concessions should run through me.

Notes for CS/Onboarding (Laura / Ben):
- Ben: provision key bound to the two CIDR ranges Priya listed and deliver via Vault link.
- Laura: please own the 10/27 smoke test meeting invite and the success-matrix sign-off.

Camila — loop me in on the 10/27 follow-up if any procurement asks surface.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales — Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
